authorization: User: etymologise all Indo-Aryan SIL surveys jointly; do everything; surface tough/unclear cases for audit once done.

proposals.evidence: CDIAL 9229 bāhu gives Hindi bā̃h “arm”, Western Pahari bā/bāi in the addendum and Bhojpuri bā̃h. Bundeli bai and Kaithal ba fit the regional contracted arm forms; intra-IA transmission is not determined. Joint comparison: Nimadi bāỹ “arm” matches reviewed bundeli_atarra baỹ “arm” (f_2axxkxclsonx2). The shared family is provisionally linked under the user’s preference; inheritance versus intra-IA borrowing is not resolved by this formal comparison.
